messages.content: How do I reset my password for the Acme Widgets portal?
Open the portal sign-in page, choose 'Forgot password', and follow the link sent to your work email.
How do I request a new laptop?
Raise a hardware request in the service catalogue and pick the standard laptop bundle.
Where do I find the VPN client?
Install it from the self-service software centre under Network tools.
My printer shows offline. What should I try?
Check the cable or Wi-Fi, restart the printer, then remove and re-add it in printer settings.
How do I book a meeting room?
Use the calendar app, add a room resource, and pick a free room for the time slot.
What is the guest Wi-Fi policy?
Guests use the visitor network with a daily code from reception; it is internet-only.
How do I enable multi-factor authentication?
Open the security settings page, choose 'Set up MFA', and register the authenticator app.
How do I report a phishing email?
Use the 'Report phish' button in your mail client; do not click links in the message.
